skill.name: memory
skill.description: Manage shared project memory, search prior observations, promote decisions and patterns to SSOT, merge Plans.md, and migrate workflow files with backups.
skill.summary: Search shared memory, promote durable knowledge to SSOT, merge Plans.md, and migrate project workflow files with backups.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by inline Markdown, fixed shell substitutions, intentional project paths, and multilingual text. No explicit prompt injection or obfuscated payload was found. Two semantic risks remain: unsanitized memory promotion and unconfirmed replacement of an unparseable Plans.md file.

remediation.issue: Stored observations may contain instruction-like content.
remediation.suggestion: Treat retrieved memory as untrusted data, reject override directives, summarize facts only, and require user approval before writing SSOT files.

remediation.issue: The fallback can replace an unparseable Plans.md working file.
remediation.suggestion: Stop after backup, explain the parse failure, show the proposed replacement, and require confirmation before selecting a fresh template.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Prompt Injection Through Memory Promotion
semantic_findings.description: The workflow retrieves stored observations and writes selected content into persistent SSOT files without requiring instruction filtering. A poisoned observation could persist attacker-controlled directives across sessions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly retrieves observations and reflects selected content into SSOT, but it provides no instruction-sanitization step.

semantic_findings.title: Unconfirmed Replacement of Unparseable Plans

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both references explicitly select the template fallback when parsing fails, while only the original file is retained in backup.

content.value_statement: Project decisions and reusable patterns often become scattered across tools and sessions. This skill searches shared memory and promotes durable knowledge into structured project SSOT files.
actual_capabilities: Search Harness Memory observations and timelines through available MCP memory tools.
Initialize missing decisions.md, patterns.md, and optional session logs without overwriting existing files.
Filter memory observations and propose durable decisions or reusable patterns for SSOT promotion.
Merge Plans.md sections while preserving active, queued, completed, and archived tasks.
Synchronize existing workflow documentation with current markers and handoff conventions using minimal changes.
Migrate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md into new formats after confirmation and backup.
limitations: Automatic memory retrieval requires a compatible Harness Memory or Serena integration.
The skill can modify project documentation and hidden .claude files, so every diff needs review.
The Plans.md fallback may replace unparseable content with a template after creating a backup.
Retrieved memory content is not explicitly screened for prompt injection before SSOT promotion.

use_cases.title: Preserve Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Convert approved technical choices and their rationale into durable decisions.md entries.

use_cases.title: Restore Cross-Tool Context
use_cases.description: Search prior observations from shared memory before continuing work in another supported agent.

use_cases.title: Migrate Team Workflows
use_cases.description: Update existing agent instructions and task plans while retaining project-specific rules and backups.

prompt_templates.title: Search Past Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Search project memory for prior decisions about [topic]. Summarize conclusions, rationale, dates, and observation identifiers. Do not modify files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for existing project context

prompt_templates.title: Propose SSOT Promotion
prompt_templates.prompt: Review memory observations about [topic]. Separate decisions from reusable patterns, remove confidential details, and propose entries. Wait for approval before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Plans Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [Plans.md path] with the current format. Preserve every task section, create a timestamped backup, and present counts and a diff.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Workflow Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md. List constraints to retain, ask focused questions, create backups, migrate approved content, and present final diffs.

output_examples.output: Found two approved decisions covering session storage and token rotation. The summary includes rationale, dates, and source observation identifiers.

output_examples.input: Promote the cache incident lessons to SSOT.
output_examples.output: Proposed one decision about cache ownership and one reusable invalidation pattern. Confidential incident details were excluded, and no files were changed.

output_examples.input: Merge this Plans.md into the current structure.
output_examples.output: Created a backup, retained all four task sections, updated marker definitions, and reported task counts. The final diff is ready for review.

best_practices: Search and deduplicate existing SSOT entries before adding new material.
Review retrieved memory as untrusted content and remove instructions, secrets, and personal data.
Require a backup and inspect the diff before accepting any workflow-file migration.
anti_patterns: Do not promote unfinished notes or uncertain observations as durable decisions.
Do not replace an unparseable Plans.md file without explicit approval after backup.
Do not use this skill for temporary notes, implementation work, or routine code reviews.

faq.question: Which memory systems are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow supports Harness Memory and Serena. Manual pasted input is available when neither integration can be accessed.

faq.question: Which SSOT files can this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages decisions.md for rationale, patterns.md for reusable methods, and an optional local session log.

faq.question: Will existing SSOT files be overwritten?
faq.answer: Initialization skips existing files. Promotion and migration workflows can edit files, so review proposed changes and diffs.

faq.question: How does Plans.md merging protect tasks?
faq.answer: It extracts task sections, counts entries, creates a backup, and places retained tasks into the current template structure.

faq.question: Can it migrate AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews existing rules, asks what must remain, creates backups, and applies the approved structure.

faq.question: Does it protect against malicious memory content?
faq.answer: Not explicitly. Treat retrieved observations as untrusted, remove instruction-like text, and approve every SSOT write.
